name: Callable Update
description: Changes a callable in your namespace: its operation, caps, gate or description. What is left out stays as it is; gate: null removes its gate. Calls already running see the new caps at their next action. Needs callable/manage on x/callable/<name> and the authority the callable was created with.

caps.description: The capabilities bounding what it may do: an array of {with, can} capabilities, or "unrestricted"

gate.description: The operation deciding who else may call it, or null to remove it

description.description: What it does, for its callers
